title: A very abrupt change why?
author: Healthy-Ad7070
selftext:
I created an EUR/USD trading bot based on a simple concept that the price seems to repeat constantly. I backtested it from January 1, 2026, to July 1, 2026, and the results are very, very good.  
However, as soon as I extend the backtest before January 1, 2026 (for example, to December 1, 2025), everything changes abruptly. My strategy suddenly becomes completely unprofitable, almost as if it’s a totally different strategy.  
How is it possible that the strategy performs so well starting on January 1, 2026, but becomes unprofitable as soon as the test includes December 31, 2025, and earlier?  
Do you think this could be caused by a very sudden change in market behavior, which seems quite strange, or could there be another explanation?

comments.author: CheapConstruction659
comments.body: This strategy is literally just gambling. Without accounting for anything besides "it's a revolving stock", there's no way that backtesting it is going to give you any meaningful data.

replies.author: Healthy-Ad7070
replies.body: You don’t even know what strategy I use btw 🥀

replies.author: CheapConstruction659
replies.body: That is true. So now we get to the real question: how can anyone here offer any sort of advice or insight when you provided no information about your strategy?
